name: microsoft-graph-connection
description: Connecting the Microsoft Graph MCP Server for Enterprise (public preview) through the Wyre gateway: BYOC multi-tenant Entra app registration, the tenantId/clientId/clientSecret triple, the delegated MCP.* permissions and the per-tenant admin consent that must be granted out of band, plus the read-only design, the 100 calls/min/user limit, licensing implications, and a symptom-to-cause troubleshooting table.
